sponsored.t: Relates to qualifications for holding the office of deputy sheriff in the county of Montgomery
sponsored.sum: Expands the area outside Montgomery county in which a deputy sheriff in Montgomery county may reside.

sponsored.t: Relates to qualifications for holding the office of correction officer in the county of Montgomery
sponsored.sum: Allows persons holding the office of correction officer in the county of Montgomery to be a resident of certain other counties.

sponsored.t: Establishes enhanced educational continuity reviews for certain students transitioning to home instruction
sponsored.sum: Establishes enhanced educational continuity reviews for certain students transitioning to home instruction; requires school districts to review whether the individualized home instruction plan for a child is being implemented as required pursuant to law and regulations.

sponsored.t: Prohibits school districts from authorizing a currently enrolled public school student from being home schooled in certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Prohibits school districts from authorizing a currently enrolled public school student to be home schooled when the superintendent of the school district is notified of a pending child abuse or neglect investigation or if either custodial parent or a person instructing the child has been convicted of domestic violence, child abuse, or neglect.

sponsored.t: Enacts the technical evaluation, risk monitoring, incident notification, AI testing, oversight, and response act or the TERMINATOR Act
sponsored.sum: Relates to independent safety evaluations, monitoring, reporting, security, mitigation, employee protections and enforcement relating to frontier artificial intelligence models.

sponsored.t: Relates to the crime of promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child
sponsored.sum: Includes the act of, when knowing the character and content thereof, a person produces, directs or promotes any obscene synthetic sexual performance, as committing the crime of promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child; defines "obscene synthetic sexual performance".

sponsored.t: Authorizes the South End Children's Cafe to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the city of Albany assessor
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the South End Children's Cafe Inc. to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the city of Albany assessor for all applicable taxes from the 2025-2026 assessment rolls.

sponsored.t: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Amsterdam
sponsored.sum: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Amsterdam; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2031.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Patrick LaFortune Jr.
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system constituting state route nine-W within the town of Bethlehem, at the town line bordering the city of Albany until its intersection with Moriah road, to Patrick LaFortune Jr.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a purple alert program to assist in the location and safe recovery of missing vulnerable persons
sponsored.sum: Directs the division of state police to establish and administer a purple alert program to assist in the location and safe recovery of missing vulnerable persons.

sponsored.t: Relates to adaptive aquatic safety services for individuals with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to adaptive aquatic safety services for individuals with disabilities; directs the commissioner of health to evaluate and seek approval for the inclusion of adaptive aquatic safety services as an available service component under applicable Medicaid home and community-based services authorities; relates to adaptive aquatic accessibility at state-funded public aquatic facilities; directs the commissioner of health to promulgate regulations requiring lifeguard certification and recertification courses to include instruction concerning aquatic safety for individuals with disabilities; authorizes school districts and boards of cooperative educational services to incorporate adaptive…

sponsored.t: Requires public schools to follow seizure action plans developed by health care providers of students diagnosed with a seizure disorder
sponsored.sum: Requires public schools to follow seizure action plans developed by health care providers of students diagnosed with a seizure disorder; requires schools to provide seizure awareness training to certain employees on the recognition of signs and symptoms of a seizure and the appropriate steps to be taken to respond to such symptoms.

sponsored.t: Grants the gaming commission the authority to develop, and require racetrack operators to implement, fire protection systems requirements for stables and barns
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Grants the gaming commission the authority to develop, and require racetrack operators to implement, fire protection systems requirements for stables and barns used to house horses at racetracks.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sale of private-label liquor at retail for consumption off the premises
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the sale of private-label liquor at retail for consumption off the premises by certain licensed distillers; requires the labels of such private-label liquors to indicate that the distiller is licensed in New York state; requires reporting.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions of law relating to the closure or transfer of a state-operated individualized residential alternative
sponsored.sum: Extends for two years the requirement for OPWDD to give a 90-day notice to the Senate, Assembly, and labor organizations of any closures or transfer of a state operated individualized residential alternative.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions of law relating to the care demonstration program
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of law relating to the care demonstration program from March 31, 2026 until March 31, 2028.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to CW2 John M. Grassia III
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a bridge on I-88 in the town of Rotterdam to CW2 John M. Grassia III.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York fundamental artificial intelligence requirements in (FAIR) news act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York fundamental artificial intelligence requirements in (FAIR) news act"; provides transparency requirements for news media content composed, authored, or otherwise created through generative AI.

sponsored.t: Relates to disclosure of amounts in trust for the perpetual care of cemetery lots
sponsored.sum: Requires biennial disclosure by trustees or executors of amounts in trust for the perpetual care of cemetery lots to a cemetery association.

sponsored.t: Relates to peer-to-peer mobile payment service security
sponsored.sum: Directs every peer-to-peer mobile service to require users to create a personal identification code associated with the user's account that is required to be used when certain actions are taken and to require users to set a monetary amount for intended transfers above which the use of a personal identification number will be required to authenticate the user's identity.

sponsored.t: Allows municipalities to relieve property owners of penalties due to lack of payment if such property owner was a victim of property tax fraud
sponsored.sum: Allows municipalities to relieve victims of property tax fraud from penalties arising from lack of payment of property taxes.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York State Department of Labor to establish a voluntary training and certification program for employers that have taken the Neurodiversity Training Pledge
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York State Department of Labor to establish a voluntary training and certification program for employers entitled the Neurodiversity Training Pledge.

sponsored.t: Relates to issuing the village of Nelliston incorporation documents
sponsored.sum: Directs the secretary of State to issue to the village of Nelliston in the Town of Palatine, Montgomery county, a certificate of incorporation verifying the status of the village of Nelliston as incorporated as a village since 1878.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring Medicaid to cover a wearable medical device to treat certain forms of cancer
sponsored.sum: Requires Medicaid to cover a wearable medical device that uses low-intensity, alternating electric fields delivered to the tumor site to treat glioblastoma and other cancers as recommended by medical and scientific evidence.
sponsored.fis: This legislation will have a minimal fiscal impact to Medicaid.

sponsored.t: Relates to sanctions with regard to to substantiated reports of abuse or neglect which are no longer subject to amendment or appeal
sponsored.sum: Relates to sanctions by the office of the Medicaid inspector general with regard to substantiated reports of abuse or neglect which are no longer subject to amendment or appeal.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Katie Adamek
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Katie Adamek, who is an employee of the Schenectady City School District beginning November 23, 2009.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Duane Lake, in the town of Duanesburg, county of Schenectady, to participate in the septic system replacement fund
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Duane Lake, in the town of Duanesburg, county of Schenectady, to participate in the septic system replacement fund.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Mohawk River Basin management act
sponsored.sum: Establishes a Mohawk River Basin district and Mohawk River Basin management program for management of such district to preserve, protect, restore and enhance the environmental quality of the Mohawk River.

sponsored.t: Grants peace officer status to security officers employed by Albany Memorial Hospital, Samaritan Hospital, and St. Peter's Hospital
sponsored.sum: Grants peace officer status to security officers employed by Albany Memorial Hospital, Samaritan Hospital, and St. Peter's Hospital when acting pursuant to their special duties on the grounds or premises owned, controlled or administered by any such hospital or any of its subsidiaries.

sponsored.t: Requires the council on arts to make recommendations on the renaming of the agency buildings located at the empire state plaza
sponsored.sum: Requires the council on arts to make recommendations on the renaming of the agency buildings located at the empire state plaza; requires the governor to choose the new agency building names within 60 days after the council's recommendation.

sponsored.t: Relates to the protection of people with special needs and the confidentiality of certain documents
sponsored.sum: Relates to confidentiality in cases involving the protection of people with special needs; allows the state comptroller's office to unseal certain documents.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the city of Albany to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Albany to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy.

sponsored.t: Enacts the consumer wheelchair repair bill of rights act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "consumer wheelchair repair bill of rights act" requiring manufacturers to make available certain documentation, parts, embedded software, firmware, or tools necessary for repairing equipment; establishes a timely repair for wheelchair program; deems all wheelchair repairs needed within 5 years of initial prescription medically necessary.

sponsored.t: Designates records and information relating to a patient who has been deceased for a period of fifty years or longer as historic records no longer subject to privacy protections
sponsored.sum: Designates records and information relating to a patient who has been deceased for a period of fifty years or longer as historic records no longer subject to privacy protections; provides that such provisions shall not be construed as requiring a facility to retain records for any particular length of time.

sponsored.t: Directs empire state development, in conjunction with the office of general services, to create plans for the development of mixed-use commercial and residential property at, and redesign of, the Harriman campus
sponsored.sum: Directs empire state development, in conjunction with the office of general services, to create a plan to develop mixed-use commercial and residential property on a certain portion of the Harriman campus; directs such plan to be completed and made available for public comment no later than 180 days after the effective date; directs empire state development, in conjunction with the office of general services, to create a master plan for the redesign of the Harriman campus; directs that such plan be completed and made available for public comment no later than one year after the effective date.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring food service establishments to permit the use of reusable beverage and food containers provided by customers
sponsored.sum: Requires food service establishments to permit the use of reusable beverage and food containers provided by customers when requesting a beverage refill or requesting leftovers from a partially consumed meal to be packaged and post signs to inform customers that they are permitted to do so.

sponsored.t: Relates to holders of certain operating certificates authorized to provide behavioral analysis services, or to employ or contract with applied behavior analysts and mental health counselors
sponsored.sum: Authorizes holders of certain operating certificates for treatment of persons with developmental disabilities to provide behavioral analysis services, so long as the professional providing such services is operating within their scope of practice; authorizes holders of such operating certificates to employ or contract with applied behavior analysts and mental health counselors.

sponsored.t: Relates to placing restrictions on the sale of flare guns
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crimes of criminal sale of a flare gun in the first and second degrees; sets restrictions on and requirements for the sale of flare guns.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of authorizing big game hunting in Albany county
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions authorizing big game hunting in Albany county until October 1, 2028.

sponsored.t: Provides for licensing of a dental therapist
sponsored.sum: Requires individuals who practice the profession of dental therapy to be licensed and registered in the state; provides Medicaid reimbursement for dental therapy services.

sponsored.t: Relates to the authority of the capital district regional off-track betting corporation to retain and disburse certain uncashed tickets
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to the authority of the capital district regional off-track betting corporation to retain and disburse certain uncashed tickets to the corporations' participating counties.

sponsored.t: Requires 911 call-takers and dispatchers to complete T-CPR training
Relates to former patients interred at present and former state mental health hospital cemeteries
sponsored.sum: Provides for the availability of certain records of former patients interred at state mental health hospital cemeteries.

sponsored.t: Relates to unclaimed winnings and refunds and the remittance of taxes
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Requires a regional off-track betting corporation that is comprised in the capital district to distribute unclaimed winnings and refunds to participating counties comprising the capital district corporation; provides penalties for late distributions; provides for the remittance of pari-mutuel wagering taxes.

sponsored.t: Relates to school aid for transportation of children attending a universal pre-kindergarten program; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to application of certain school aid funds towards transportation of children attending a universal pre-kindergarten program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the responsibility for certain temporary-resident preschool children with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the responsibility of school districts for certain temporary-resident preschool children with disabilities who are in foster care, are homeless or are in residential care.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "connected consumer product end of life disclosure act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "connected consumer product end of life disclosure act", relating to requiring manufacturers of connected consumer products to disclose for how long they will provide technical support, security updates, or bug fixes for the software, hardware, or firmware necessary for the product to securely function.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing education and outreach programs related to home visiting programs
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing education and outreach programs related to home visiting programs which provide support for pregnant and parenting families, and have been proven to improve outcomes for mothers, infants, and families; provides that such information shall include information on services available from such programs, eligibility, and relevant contact information.

sponsored.t: Changes the amount of the exemption permitted for capital improvements to residential buildings
sponsored.sum: Changes the amount of the exemption permitted for capital improvements to residential buildings to $200,000 where a local law or resolution is adopted on or after January 1, 2026.

sponsored.t: Authorizes all municipalities to join a county self-funded or self-insured health plan
sponsored.sum: Authorizes all municipalities, with the consent of the county and the governing body of such municipality, to join a county self-funded or self-insured health plan; requires certification.

sponsored.t: Requires require prospective licensees of cannabis licenses to submit a formal attestation of compliance with local zoning laws, land-use regulations, and municipal code requirements
sponsored.sum: Requires prospective licensees of cannabis licenses to submit a formal attestation of compliance with local zoning laws, land-use regulations, and municipal code requirements and proof of local municipal compliance to the Cannabis Control Board when applying for an OCM Cannabis license, and give municipalities the ability to request an extension of time to submit an opinion on the prospective licensee application.

sponsored.t: Establishes a sales tax exemption for the purchase of electric wheelchair accessible vehicles
sponsored.sum: Establishes a sales tax exemption for the purchase of electric vehicles that are designed for the purpose of transporting persons in wheelchairs or containing any physical device or alteration designed to permit access to and enable the transportation of persons in wheelchairs.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the New York state archives partnership trust fund to be used for the benefit of the New York state museum and the New York state library
sponsored.sum: Provides that the purposes, powers and authorized expenditures of the New York state archives partnership trust board may be exercised for the benefit of the New York state museum and the New York state library, in addition to the New York state archives.

sponsored.t: Relates to fully autonomous vehicles
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the use of fully autonomous vehicles in Albany and Rensselaer counties until July 1, 2028; provides for operation, licensing, insurance, duties following crashes, on-demand autonomous vehicle networks, registration and titles, operation by human drivers, and related provisions.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Creating Lasting Access to Supported and Inclusive Careers for New York (CLASSIC NY) act
sponsored.sum: Establishes a disability employment innovation fund; authorizes the issuance of "Classic NY" series license plates consisting of reissued historical license plate designs; authorizes the commissioner of motor vehicles to identify, reserve, and auction certain license plate configurations that are determined to have elevated market value; directs proceeds of "Classic NY" series plates and any auctioned plates to be deposited into the disability employment innovation fund.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of transportation to conduct a traffic and planning study on the feasibility of transforming the Harriman campus in connection with the relocation of the Wadsworth Laboratory at Harriman
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of transportation to conduct a traffic and planning study on the feasibility of transforming the Harriman campus in connection with the relocation of the Wadsworth Laboratory at Harriman; directs a report on the findings of such study to be delivered within one year of effectiveness.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Sgt Henry Johnson
sponsored.sum: Dedicates the bridge located on Interstate 90, designated as Bridge Number 1092839, which crosses over the Hudson River in the cities of Albany and Rensselaer to Sgt Henry Johnson.

sponsored.t: Establishes a pilot program to improve equity and efficiency in housing for people with developmental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Establishes a pilot program in partnership with a nonprofit organization to improve equity and efficiency in housing for people with developmental disabilities by encouraging shared housing.
sponsored.fis: The pilot will operate with existing resources and oversight from OPWDD, with no additional state appropriation required at this time.

sponsored.t: Establishes a task force to study and make recommendations on chronic absenteeism at public schools in the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Establishes a task force to study and make recommendations on chronic absenteeism at public schools in the state of New York; establishes reporting requirements.

sponsored.t: Establishes the statewide group home families working group
sponsored.sum: Establishes the statewide group home families working group; provides that duties include informing and advising the commissioner as to matters of importance for persons with developmental disabilities residing in group homes and their families and guardians, providing recommendations for statewide and regional priorities and goals for individuals residing in group homes and families and guardians of individuals residing in group homes, advising the commissioner on such other matters related to group homes as the statewide group home families working group deems relevant, holding regional public meetings to solicit and receive input from residents of group homes and family members and…

sponsored.t: Establishes a portable clearance passport program to satisfy certain background checks
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the office of children and family services to develop a portable clearance passport program to provide a uniform process for conducting background checks for employment at certain participating agencies.

sponsored.t: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the town of Rotterdam
sponsored.sum: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the town of Rotterdam; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2031.

sponsored.t: Establishes the blue-ribbon commission on the future of New York state's service delivery system for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "blue-ribbon commission on the future of New York state's service delivery system for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities act" to conduct a study and prepare a report to examine, evaluate and make recommendations for systemic reforms to ensure a sustainable set of supports and services that meets the evolving needs of all individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to the duties of the independent developmental disability ombudsperson program
sponsored.sum: Directs the independent developmental disability ombudsperson program to establish a service delivery structure based in New York state that includes a toll-free telephone hotline, an interactive website, and availability of in-person, telephone and email access to ombudsperson program staff or volunteers; to provide assistance for navigating and completing processes; to assist individuals in filing and preparing appeals; to assist individuals with any problems encountered; and to educate individuals on their rights and responsibilities with respect to access to services provided by the office for people with developmental disabilities and care coordination provided by health homes serving…
sponsored.fis: The estimated cost of modifying this program is approximately $1 million. Currently, the State funds this program at $2 million.

sponsored.t: Enacts the dark skies protection act
sponsored.sum: Regulates outdoor night lighting to preserve and enhance the state's dark sky.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the application of fail-first or step therapy protocols to coverage for the diagnosis and treatment of serious mental health conditions
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the application of fail-first or step therapy protocols to coverage for the diagnosis and treatment of serious mental health conditions; defines serious mental health condition.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage sharks
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage sharks.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage squid
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage squid.

sponsored.t: Relates to the utilization of renewable energy at state-owned facilities in Albany
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Renewable Capitol act"; requires the office of general services, in consultation with the power authority of the state of New York, to ensure that all operations that power, heat or cool the empire state plaza complex shall entirely use renewable energy systems; requires the office of general services to establish an advisory committee to advise the office of general services on the preparation, design and content of a plan for the use of renewable energy systems.

sponsored.t: Provides for dentist loan repayment and practice support
sponsored.sum: Provides for dentist loan repayment and practice support for dentists who agree to practice in an underserved area in the state.
sponsored.fis: $2,500,000 per year for three fiscal years.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain municipalities to impose a tax on certain high-value non-primary residences
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities located outside the city of New York to impose a tax on high-value non-primary residences having a five-year average market value threshold as set by the municipality between 2.5 and 5 million dollars or more; provides for authorized rates of taxation, administration and enforcement, and revenue distribution.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York commission for the deaf and hard of hearing act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York commission for the deaf and hard of hearing act".

sponsored.t: Establishes a deposit and recycling program for wine containers and liquor containers
sponsored.sum: Establishes a deposit and recycling program for wine containers and liquor containers with 5 cent deposits for containers less than 24 oz and 10 cent deposits for containers over 24 oz; provides for labeling of such containers; makes related provisions.
sponsored.fis: Minimal direct fiscal impact to the state. The program is funded through deposits collected by deposit originators, and revenues from the sale of recovered materials. Administrative costs are expected to be covered through program funds.

sponsored.t: Authorizes municipalities and the department of financial services to seek civil penalties for violations of the duty to maintain a foreclosed property
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities and the department of financial services to seek civil penalties for violations of the duty to maintain a foreclosed property in an amount of up to $650 per day for each day such violation persists after the judgement of foreclosure has been issued.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances; provides penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Joshua David Olsen
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Joshua David Olsen, a current tier VI member who is employed by the NYS office for people with developmental disabilities.

sponsored.t: Requires applicants for a permit, registration, or license issued by the cannabis control board to report any relevant law enforcement interactions that occur during the application review process
sponsored.sum: Requires applicants for a permit, registration, or license issued by the cannabis control board to report any relevant law enforcement interactions that occur during the application review process; provides for automatic denial of such application for failure to make such report.

sponsored.t: Enacts the CareForce first-time homebuyers act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the CareForce first-time homebuyers program under which certain first-time homebuyers may receive below-market mortgage financing and forgivable down payment assistance.
sponsored.fis: Any fiscal impact is expected to be minimal and manageable within exist- ing SONYMA bonding authority and housing finance mechanisms. Down payment assistance loans are forgivable only after sustained owner-occu- pancy or under defined conditions, limiting long-term exposure.

sponsored.t: Requires the superintendent of financial services to audit certain reports to ensure such insurers are in full compliance with federal and state mental health and substance use disorder parity requirements
sponsored.sum: Requires the superintendent of financial services to audit certain reports to ensure such insurers are in full compliance with federal and state mental health and substance use disorder parity requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to designating state university campuses as early voting sites and polling sites
sponsored.sum: Designates campuses which are operated by the state university of New York with at least sixteen thousand enrolled students and an on campus dormitory as early voting sites and polling sites; provides that such designation requirements shall not apply where an early voting site or polling site is already designated within one mile of the geographic boundaries of such campus.

sponsored.t: Relates to prosecution by the department of financial services and municipalities of certain violations regarding residential real property
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to prosecution by the department of financial services (DFS) and municipalities of certain violations regarding residential real property by mortgage lenders and similar entities; directs DFS to promulgate standards of review of whether to prosecute such violations; requires deference to municipalities where both the municipality and DFS are authorized to prosecute such a violation; directs payments of civil penalties issued pursuant to such violations to be paid to DFS if DFS is the prosecuting entity.

sponsored.t: Requires employment entities to engage in cooperative dialogue with certain persons regarding reasonable accommodations
sponsored.sum: Requires employment entities to engage in cooperative dialogue with persons requesting reasonable accommodations, or who such employment entities reasonably should have known may require such reasonable accommodations, due to disability, religion, or status as a victim of domestic violence.

sponsored.t: Requires SUNY and CUNY trustees refrain from investing in and subsequently divest from stocks, debt or other securities of certain publicly traded fossil fuel companies
sponsored.sum: Requires SUNY and CUNY trustees to refrain from investing in and subsequently divest from stocks, debt or other securities of certain publicly traded fossil fuel companies.

sponsored.t: Requires the trustees of The State University of New York to develop a SUNY-wide zero waste action plan
sponsored.sum: Requires the trustees of The State University of New York to develop a SUNY-wide zero waste action plan.

sponsored.t: Updates school concussion management and response protocols
sponsored.sum: Relates to updating school concussion management and response protocols; requires that the injured student have returned to a full class schedule without academic accommodations prior to resuming athletic activity.

sponsored.t: Relates to the prohibition on certain databases and registries
sponsored.sum: Provides that no state or local agency, or any agent thereof, may use any funds, facilities, property, equipment or personnel of such agency to investigate, enforce or provide assistance in the investigation or enforcement of any federal program requiring registration of individuals, or maintaining a database of individuals, on the basis of race, color, creed, gender, sexual orientation, religion or national or ethnic origin.

sponsored.t: Provides notice of health insurance contracts for retired officers, employees, and their families
sponsored.sum: Provides notice of health insurance contracts for retired officers, employees, and their families.
sponsored.fis: There may be minor costs associated with the distribution of the notice but cost savings from retired employees' offering cost effective alter- natives to the proposed changes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of an innovative supportive housing program for persons with a developmental disability who wish and are able to safely reside in such a setting; creates an exemption from certain filings
sponsored.sum: Relates to the creation of an innovative housing initiative for persons with a developmental disability who wish and are able to safely reside in such a setting; directs the division of housing and community renewal to establish guidelines for the dissemination of disclosure materials for the offer and sale of interests in residential environments formed under the innovative housing initiative; creates an exemption from certain filing requirements for residential environments that are formed as cooperative interests in realty for persons receiving services under the innovative housing initiative.

sponsored.t: Directs school districts to establish parent advisory councils on special education
sponsored.sum: Directs school districts to establish parent advisory councils on special education to advise on matters that pertain to the education and safety of students with disabilities, and meet regularly with school officials to participate in the planning, development, and evaluation of the school district's special education programs.

sponsored.t: Enacts the employer-assisted housing matching grant act
sponsored.sum: Creates an employer-assisted housing match grant program under which certain nonprofit employees may be eligible for a state match for certain employer-provided funds for housing costs.

sponsored.t: Relates to revoking a license to carry, possess, repair and dispose of firearms for a conviction for failure to safely store rifles, shotguns, and firearms
sponsored.sum: Relates to revoking a license to carry, possess, repair and dispose of firearms for a conviction for failure to safely store rifles, shotguns, and firearms.

sponsored.t: Relates to payment for rapid whole genome sequencing
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of social services to authorize the payment of medical assistance funds for rapid whole genome sequencing for persons under twenty-one years of age under certain medical circumstances.

sponsored.t: Requires insurance coverage for home test kits for sexually transmitted diseases
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance coverage for home test kits for sexually transmitted diseases.

sponsored.t: Relates to the criminal enforcement of violations of the state's uniform fire prevention and building code
sponsored.sum: Expands the number of parties subject to enforcement of violations of the state's uniform fire prevention and building code.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Christine Fernandez
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Christine Fernandez, formerly Christine Lennard, for her September 11, 1986 -- June 1989 employment with SUNY Buffalo.

sponsored.t: Relates to off-track betting maintenance of effort payment requirements
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Requires an off-track betting corporation that accepts wagers on the simulcasts of thoroughbred races from out-of-state or out-of-country to pay to its regional harness track or tracks an amount equal to three percent of handle generated from the acceptance of such wagers from out-of-state or out-of-country thoroughbred tracks after 7:30 P.M.

sponsored.t: Continues the New York state geological survey as a bureau within the New York state science service
sponsored.sum: Continues the New York state geological survey, originally established in 1836, as a bureau within the New York state science service; establishes the purposes and goals of the New York state geological survey.

sponsored.t: Relates to the paper carryout bag reduction fee
sponsored.sum: Implements a one year phase-in period for a local law, ordinance or resolution imposing a paper carryout bag reduction fee where forty percent of such fees are returned to such county or city for the purpose of purchasing and distributing reusable bags, with priority given to low- and fixed-income communities, and after the first year, such forty percent of fees shall be remitted to the person who collected the fees.

sponsored.t: Relates to the qualification of an applicant for the New York opportunity promise scholarship
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement that an applicant for the New York opportunity promise scholarship has not already obtained any postsecondary degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to protecting the communication rights of individuals with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to protecting the communication rights of individuals with disabilities; provides that each person with a disability has the right to autonomously communicate in their preferred manner and utilize any validated communication supports that meet their needs.

sponsored.t: Removes and updates outdated terminology and provisions of law and makes technical corrections thereto; repealer
sponsored.sum: Removes and updates outdated terminology and provisions of law; makes technical corrections thereto; removes certain provisions relating to outdated terms and provisions of law.

sponsored.t: Expands the description of certain services which are not prohibited by statutes governing the practice of nursing
sponsored.sum: Expands the description of certain services which are not prohibited by statutes governing the practice of nursing, including direct support staff to nurses.

sponsored.t: Establishes prescribed pediatric extended care centers
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to establish and administer a program for the certification, operation, and oversight of two prescribed pediatric extended care centers to provide supportive services to medically stable and medically complex children who require continual care.

sponsored.t: Provides for enhanced rates for child care services provided to disabled and/or developmentally delayed children
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of social services shall establish a rate differential for child care providers who provide care to a child with a diagnosed developmental delay or disability, provided such rate differential is no less than 30% above the applicable market rate otherwise payable for such child care services, and further provided such rate differential is sufficient to provide appropriate care.

sponsored.t: Increases the number of county court judges in Schenectady county
sponsored.sum: Increases the number of county court judges in Schenectady county from one judge to two.

sponsored.t: Relates to the election of school board members after the number of members has been increased
sponsored.sum: Provides that elections to fill an increased number of seats on a school board will be conducted at the first annual meeting after the meeting during which number of seats was increased.

sponsored.t: Increases the income cap for purposes of the Excelsior scholarship
sponsored.sum: Increases the income cap for purposes of the Excelsior scholarship from $125,000 to $150,000 for academic years 2026-2027 and thereafter.

sponsored.t: Creates an office to residential conversion tax credit and a historic preservation rehabilitation office to residential conversion tax credit
sponsored.sum: Creates an office to residential conversion tax credit which shall be administered by the empire state development corporation; creates a historic preservation rehabilitation office to residential conversion tax credit which shall be administered by the state historic preservation office.
sponsored.fis: The aggregate tax credits contained in this bill will not exceed $50 million ($25 million each tax credit).

sponsored.t: Requires the developmental disabilities advisory council to submit an annual comprehensive summary of information about its activities to the office for people with developmental disabilities' website
sponsored.sum: Requires the developmental disabilities advisory council to submit an annual comprehensive summary of information about its activities to the office for people with developmental disabilities' website, in an accessible format.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of kratom to individuals under the age of twenty-one
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of kratom to individuals under the age of twenty-one; prohibits the sale or dissemination of information recorded during transaction scans; imposes a civil penalty of not more than five hundred dollars for the sale or provision of kratom to any person under the age of twenty-one; repeals certain provisions relating thereto; repeals certain provisions requiring a study on kratom; relates to the effectiveness of a chapter of the laws of 2025 relating to prohibiting the sale of kratom to persons under the age of 21.

sponsored.t: Clarifies standards for glass repair and calibration of advanced driver assistance systems
sponsored.sum: Clarifies standards for glass repair and calibration of advanced driver assistance systems for motor vehicle glass repair facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to direct access laboratory testing for certain lipid screening assays
sponsored.sum: Provides that clinical laboratories may provide laboratory testing at the request of individuals, without a practitioner order or prescription, for certain types of cholesterol.

sponsored.t: Renames an office of addiction services and supports scholarship program the NYS Father Peter Young Memorial Addiction Professionals Scholarship Program
sponsored.sum: Renames an office of addiction services and supports scholarship program the "NYS Father Peter Young Memorial Addiction Professionals Scholarship Program"; codifies the purposes of such program as offering financial education assistance to individuals pursuing a bachelor's degree in addiction studies or the education requirements for an office of addiction services and supports credential at Alfred State College, Stony Brook University or Empire State University.

sponsored.t: Ensures identical health benefits for public retirees
sponsored.sum: Ensures that public retirees are not having their skilled nursing care benefits reduced under the state health benefit plan at the time they enroll for medicare.

sponsored.t: Provides that mobile sports wagering operators and mobile sports wagering platforms are prohibited from limiting the size and frequency of deposits or wagers or banning authorized sports bettors individually
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Provides that mobile sports wagering operators and mobile sports wagering platforms are prohibited from limiting the size and frequency of deposits or wagers of authorized sports bettors because the bettor obtains financial benefit or due to the bettor's waging activity; provides exceptions for suspicious wagering activity and indications of a gambling disorder; requires such operators and platforms to provide electronic written notice when an authorized sports bettor is limited or banned.

sponsored.t: Requires mobile sports wagering operators to establish default betting limits on their platforms and to notify authorized sports bettors of their ability to opt-out of the default betting limits
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "choice in responsible gaming act"; requires mobile sports wagering operators to establish default betting limits on their platform and to notify authorized sports bettors of their ability to opt-out of the default betting limits.

sponsored.t: Eliminates the withholding of state aid as an enforcement mechanism for court facility compliance, and establishes an appeal process for proposed court facility plans; repealer
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the withholding of state aid as an enforcement mechanism for court facility compliance; establishes an appeal process for proposed court facility plans; establishes a court facilities review panel to review the scope, reasonableness, feasibility, and proportionality of such plans.
sponsored.fis: No fiscal impact on the state

sponsored.t: Relates to disclosures by sellers of digital goods
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a seller of a digital good from advertising or offering for sale a digital good to a purchaser with the terms "buy," "purchase," or any other term which a reasonable person would understand to confer an unrestricted ownership interest in the digital good, or alongside an option for a time-limited rental, unless the seller receives at the time of each transaction an affirmative acknowledgment from the purchaser, or the seller provides to the consumer before executing each transaction a clear and conspicuous statement.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Justin Finkle to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible list for employment as a police officer for the town of Bethlehem
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Justin Finkle to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible list for employment as a full-time police officer for the town of Bethlehem; requires that Justin Finkle be otherwise subject to the merit and fitness provisions of the civil service law applicable to full-time police officers.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "dollars for diesels act" relating to financial incentives for the retirement of certain heavy- and medium-duty diesel-powered vehicles
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "dollars for diesels act"; directs the commissioner of environmental conservation, in consultation with the New York state energy research and development authority, to establish and administer a program to provide financial incentives to owners of heavy- and medium-duty diesel-powered vehicles of a model year two thousand ten or older to retire and replace such vehicles with new heavy- or medium-duty diesel-powered vehicles of model year two thousand twenty-four or newer that meet or exceed applicable emission standards.

sponsored.t: Relates to degree-granting programs offered by SUNY's office of higher education in prison
sponsored.sum: Creates within SUNY an office of higher education in prison to coordinate access to higher education for individuals during and after incarceration; directs such office to create a plan by 1/1/2029 to establish a degree-granting program in every viable correctional facility in the state; directs such office to enroll at least 2,000 students in degree-granting programs as soon as practicable; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to endangering the welfare of a child
sponsored.sum: Tolls the statute of limitations for endangering the welfare of a child until such child reaches the age of twenty-three.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "reporting of arrests, detentions, actions and removals by immigration enforcement (RADAR) act"
sponsored.sum: Requires the creation of an immigration enforcement activity transparency dashboard, which shall be made publicly available, to track certain information relating to immigration authorities activities within New York state.

sponsored.t: Updates the fee collected by county clerks for deposit into the cultural education account
sponsored.sum: Updates the fee collected by county clerks and clerks for the city of New York for deposit into the cultural education account from $15 to $30; increases the amount retained by the county or city from $0.75 to $1.00.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a weighted selection process for the allocation of certain prekindergarten seats
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a weighted selection process prioritizing children who would be eligible to receive free or reduced price lunch and/or who are emergent multilingual learners for the allocation of certain prekindergarten seats in school districts where there are more eligible children than can be served in a given school year.

sponsored.t: Relates to plastic carryout bags provided by restaurants
sponsored.sum: Removes the exemption for restaurants, taverns or similar food service establishments from the New York state bag waste reduction act.

sponsored.t: Relates to regulation of PFAS as a toxic air pollutant
sponsored.sum: Relates to regulation of PFAS as a toxic air pollutant; requires the department to ensure certain process operations use appropriate control technology for PFAS emissions; establishes a fence line monitoring program to monitor PFAS emissions in disadvantaged communities, to provide public reports, and related duties.

sponsored.t: Relates to penalties for striking a pedestrian crossing a street while operating a motor vehicle
sponsored.sum: Relates to penalties for striking a pedestrian crossing a street while operating a motor vehicle.

sponsored.t: Directs a study on the feasibility of adjusting the compulsory attendance age of minors attending full time instruction
sponsored.sum: Directs a study on the feasibility of adjusting the compulsory attendance age of minors attending full time instruction; requires report and recommendations on or before July 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to the criteria for determining tuition assistance program awards
sponsored.sum: Relates to the criteria for determining tuition assistance program awards; provides for the elimination of the distinction between dependent students and independent students for the purpose of determining tuition assistance program award amounts and eligibility.

sponsored.t: Relates to the regulation of the sale of plastic trash bags
sponsored.sum: Regulates the sale of plastic trash bags; requires plastic trash bags be made of 30% post-consumer materials.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the phase-out threshold for tuition assistance program awards
sponsored.sum: Relates to increasing the phase-out threshold for tuition assistance program awards from seven thousand dollars to eighteen thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Relates to benefits and supplemental wages
sponsored.sum: Prohibits agreements to pay or provide benefits or wage supplements from including a provision specifying that an employee with accrued, unused vacation pay will not be compensated for such vacation pay upon termination; provides for a minimum of two weeks of wages upon termination to employees who receive granted time.

sponsored.t: Relates to exemptions granted for alterations or rehabilitation
sponsored.sum: Relates to exemptions granted for alterations or rehabilitation.

sponsored.t: Establishes the small wholesaler liquor license
sponsored.sum: Establishes the small wholesaler liquor license; provides that the fee for such license is two thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurance coverage for craniofacial disorders
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance coverage for craniofacial disorders.

sponsored.t: Categorizes the assault of a code enforcement official or other individual responsible for building inspection as a class D felony
sponsored.sum: Categorizes the assault of a code enforcement official or other individual responsible for building inspection performing their lawful duties under such position as a class D felony.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Elijah Missionary Baptist Church to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Albany tax assessor to grant retroactive real property tax exempt status to Elijah Missionary Baptist Church.

sponsored.t: Prohibits parking, standing, or stopping within ten feet of a bus stop
sponsored.sum: Prohibits parking, standing, or stopping within ten feet of a bus stop.

sponsored.t: Categorizes the assault of an individual responsible for local parking enforcement as a class D felony
sponsored.sum: Categorizes the assault of an individual responsible for local parking enforcement performing their lawful duties under such position as a class D felony.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study on the distribution of traffic fines
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study on the distribution of traffic fines and to issue a report on the matter.

sponsored.t: Relates to the service life requirement for painting, striping and other new infrastructure dedicated primarily for pedestrian or cyclist use
sponsored.sum: Enables federal aid municipal street and highway funding for projects for painting, striping and other new infrastructure dedicated primarily for pedestrian or cyclist use notwithstanding the ten year service life requirement.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "higher education closure advanced notice act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "higher education closure advanced notice act"; requires an institution of higher education to provide notice of an order of closure that can be reasonably expected to cause an interruption in the continuity of a program of higher education for affected students at least ninety days before such order of closure takes effect; provides exceptions where an institution of higher education is not required to provide notice of such an order of closure at least ninety days before such order of closure takes effect; provides for a civil penalty for violations.

sponsored.t: Extends historic homeownership rehabilitation tax credit and requires additional reporting
sponsored.sum: Extends the benefit window of the historic homeownership rehabilitation tax credit; requires additional reporting on the utilization of such credit.

sponsored.t: Provides for the advance payment of the earned income tax credit
sponsored.sum: Provides for the advance payment of the earned income tax credit to qualifying employees.

sponsored.t: Provides that the failure by the utilization review agent to make a determination within certain time periods shall be deemed to be an approval of the health care services
sponsored.sum: Provides that the failure by the utilization review agent to make a determination within certain time periods shall be deemed to be an approval of the health care services.

sponsored.t: Relates to distributing purse monies more equitably
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Requires written consent of the New York thoroughbred horsemen's association representing at least fifty-one percent of the horsemen using the facilities of the franchised corporation prior to allocation or spending of funds from certain accounts.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state museum partnership trust
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state museum partnership trust to serve as a focal point for the receipt and administration of private gifts, devises and bequests of real and personal property donated to further historic preservation, advance cultural education, and enhance the state museum.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sale of digital electronic equipment and providing diagnostic and repair information
sponsored.sum: Modifies what qualifies as an original equipment manufacturer and the manufacture date when hardware must comply with the right to repair law; repeals certain limitations on the right to repair law.

sponsored.t: Requires forest management plans for certain lands and forbids clearcutting without, and increases the jurisdiction of the Adirondack park agency over clearcutting
sponsored.sum: Requires forest management plans, subject to the approval of the department of environmental conservation, for certain lands subject to a conservation easement purchased by the state; forbids clearcutting on such lands without such forest management plan; increases the jurisdiction of the Adirondack park agency over clearcutting.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of health to authorize additional reimbursement to providers of health and dental care primarily serving individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities for certain services
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health to authorize additional reimbursement to providers of health and dental care primarily serving individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities for uncompensated time, use of staff, and services that are necessary to support treatment of a patient as a result of the patient's physical, intellectual, or developmental disability.

sponsored.t: Exempts athletic club membership dues from a sales tax
sponsored.sum: Exempts athletic club membership dues from a sales tax where such dues are spent on the improvement, maintenance or operation of the athletic club's activities occurring solely on the premises of a municipal parkland.

sponsored.t: Relates to reimbursement for coroner and medical examiner fees from the county where the decedent resided
sponsored.sum: Relates to reimbursement for coroner and medical examiner fees from the county where the decedent resided.
sponsored.fis: None to the State of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to the period during which the empire state digital gaming tax credit may be claimed, criteria for such tax credit, and allowing a rollover of such credit
sponsored.sum: Extends the period during which the empire state digital gaming tax credit may be claimed to 01/01/2032; amends the eligibility criteria for game development companies by changing the yearly timeframe structure, lowering the dollar threshold per production, and removing the in-state cost incurred threshold to accurately fit current digital gaming industry models; allows unused credits to be rolled over to the following tax year.
sponsored.fis: Up to $5 million a year in tax expenditures

sponsored.t: Prohibits the withholding of state funding for service providers for people with developmental disabilities due to the receipt of certain COVID-19 federal funds
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the withholding of state funding for service providers for people with developmental disabilities due to the receipt of certain COVID-19 federal funds.

sponsored.t: Relates to the purchase of domestically produced personal protective equipment
sponsored.sum: Relates to the purchase of personal protective equipment and medical supplies produced or manufactured in the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to access to reports of child abuse and maltreatment by criminal justice agencies; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to access to reports of child abuse and maltreatment by criminal justice agencies; requires the office of children and family services to establish a centralized database of reports of child abuse and maltreatment for criminal justice agencies to access in the performance of their duties; defines criminal justice agencies.

sponsored.t: Adds services delivered to individuals with developmental disabilities to the requirement that telehealth services be reimbursed at the applicable in person rates or fees regardless of location
sponsored.sum: Adds services delivered, to individuals with developmental disabilities and traumatic brain injury, through a facility licensed under article twenty-eight of the public health law, to the requirement that telehealth services be reimbursed at the applicable in person rates or fees regardless of the location of the patient or the clinician.

sponsored.t: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to produce and publish a report on staffing at state-operated institutions under the jurisdiction of such office
sponsored.sum: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to produce and publish a report to assess the staffing and other issues causing the continued displacement of individuals with developmental disabilities from various state-operated institutions under the jurisdiction of the office for people with developmental disabilities.

sponsored.t: Establishes a direct support professional worker registry
sponsored.sum: Establishes a direct support professional worker registry of persons who have successfully completed a direct support professional worker education or training program approved by the commissioner or the accrediting body of other states or federal authorities, including the military.

sponsored.t: Relates to housing navigation services for those with intellectual and developmental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Establishes a curriculum and task force to provide housing navigation services for those with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

sponsored.t: Establishes a direct support wage enhancement to employees that provide direct care support or any other form of treatment, to individuals with developmental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Establishes a direct support wage enhancement to employees that provide direct care support or any other form of treatment, to individuals with developmental disabilities and whose income is less than $125,000.

sponsored.t: Establishes a pilot program to create an assistance hotline for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities and complex behavioral needs
sponsored.sum: Establishes a pilot program to create an assistance hotline for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities and complex behavioral needs.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the operation of uncrewed aircraft, including drones, over school grounds or critical infrastructure
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the operation of uncrewed aircraft, including drones, over school grounds or critical infrastructure; provides penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Requires a surety bond for contractors and subcontractors where no public fund has been established for the financing of a public improvement
sponsored.sum: Requires a surety bond for contractors and subcontractors where no public fund has been established for the financing of a public improvement.

sponsored.t: Authorizes payment of additional state aid for certain state-leased or state-owned lands
sponsored.sum: Authorizes payment of additional state aid for certain state-leased or state-owned lands.

sponsored.t: Requires state agencies to develop a 5-year accessibility plan providing full access to the physical facilities, services, programs, and activities for persons with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Requires each agency to develop and implement a five-year accessibility plan, to include: the steps the agency is taking and will be taking over the next 5 years to ensure accessibility to the agency's facilities, services, and programs for persons with disabilities, and information on ongoing projects and projects planned over the next 5 years related to improving physical, digital and programmatic access, and effective communications for persons with disabilities.

sponsored.t: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to submit a detailed report of proposed savings and investment initiatives within the executive budget
sponsored.sum: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to submit a detailed report of proposed savings and investment initiatives within the executive budget.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax deduction for expenses related to early intervention supplies
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax deduction for expenses not in excess of five hundred dollars paid by eligible qualified personnel or an eligible service coordinator for early intervention supplies.

sponsored.t: Relates to the reimbursement of local services provided to persons with a disability
sponsored.sum: Relates to the reimbursement of local services provided to persons with a disability; provides for retroactive reimbursement if local services were furnished prior to approval.

sponsored.t: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to develop and maintain a community residence opportunities waitlist
sponsored.sum: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to develop and maintain a community residence opportunities waitlist which includes the names and contact information of all individuals seeking placement in a community residence.

sponsored.t: Requires that instruction in the laws relating to handicapped parking be included in the pre-licensing driver's course
sponsored.sum: Relates to parking spaces for handicapped persons; provides that the commissioner of motor vehicles shall provide in any pre-licensing course a mandatory component of education of the laws relating to handicapped accessible parking.

sponsored.t: Authorizes school districts that provide transition services to allow the delivery of such transition services, including integrated employment, during school hours
sponsored.sum: Authorizes school districts that provide transition services to allow the delivery of such transition services, including integrated employment, during school hours.

sponsored.t: Requires an independent firm to conduct a study on the OPWDD eligibility criteria and determinations following diagnostic evaluations by a licensed professional and distribution of services
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of the office for people with developmental disabilities to work with an independent firm to allow such firm to conduct a study on the OPWDD eligibility criteria and determinations following diagnostic evaluations by a licensed professional and distribution of services.

sponsored.t: Criminalizes acting as a runner or soliciting or employing a runner to procure patients or clients
sponsored.sum: Criminalizes acting as a runner or soliciting or employing a runner to procure patients or clients.

sponsored.t: Requires manufacturers to provide access to motor vehicle data to motor vehicle owners and designees
sponsored.sum: Requires manufacturers to provide access to motor vehicle data to motor vehicle owners and designees; provides certain exceptions; repeals upon enactment of similar federal legislation.

sponsored.t: Relates to land banks
sponsored.sum: Authorizes land banks to lend money, to make grants and take and hold real and personal property as security for the payment of funds so loaned or for the performance and enforcement of grant agreements.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of the water-based fire protection licensure act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the water-based fire protection licensure act, setting forth licensure requirements for contractors engaged in the business of the layout, installing, repairing, inspecting, testing, or maintaining of water-based fire protection systems and components.

sponsored.t: Relates to reimbursement for residential habilitation services
sponsored.sum: Relates to reimbursement for residential habilitation services.

sponsored.t: Relates to licensing restrictions for manufacturers and wholesalers of alcoholic beverages on licensees who sell at retail and for on-premises consumption
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain pieces of property from licensing restrictions for manufacturers and wholesalers of alcoholic beverages on licensees who sell at retail and for on-premises consumption.

sponsored.t: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to create a staffing plan for workforce emergencies when experiencing staffing shortages
sponsored.sum: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to create a staffing plan for workforce emergencies when experiencing staffing shortages.

sponsored.t: Relates to the application of certain provisions relating to the operating component of rates of payment made by governmental agencies for certain services
sponsored.sum: Relates to the application of certain provisions relating to the operating component of rates of payment made by governmental agencies for facilities that provide extensive nursing, medical, psychological and counseling support services solely to children.

sponsored.t: Provides for transferring control of a defendant's connected devices in a family offense proceeding
sponsored.sum: Provides that upon motion and after an opportunity to be heard, a court may order the defendant in a family offense proceeding to turn control of a connected device over to a family or household member or, if that is not possible, to have such connected device disabled by the manufacturer.

sponsored.t: Relates to training requirements for police officers on the operation of police vehicles
sponsored.sum: Directs the municipal police training council to develop, and the commissioner of the division of criminal justice services to implement, certain training requirements for police officers on the operation of police vehicles, including a minimum of 40 hours of training for new police officers and 4 hours of training for police in-service training courses.

sponsored.t: Establishes the human services wage commission
sponsored.sum: Establishes the human services wage commission for the purpose of investigating whether the wages paid to human services workers are sufficient to provide adequate maintenance and to protect the health and welfare of employees; defines terms; provides for the duties of the commission; requires reporting.
sponsored.fis: No immediate fiscal impact to the State for the Wage Commission. Future fiscal impacts will be determined based on the Commission's findings and recommendations.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Capital Region preceptor stipend program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the Capital Region preceptor stipend program to be administered by the office of the professions, under which qualified preceptor clinicians shall receive a $5,000 stipend; provides for such funds to be distributed from the office of the professions account.

sponsored.t: Relates to transition feasibility analysis for zero-emission buses
sponsored.sum: Requires every school district to conduct a transition feasibility analysis within the next succeeding school year as of the effective date of this act, and every five years thereafter, to determine the feasibility of using zero-emission school buses on current routes.

sponsored.t: Relates to certificates of registration for entities that manufacture or assemble zero emissions vehicles and have no franchised motor vehicle dealers in New York
sponsored.sum: Limits the number of certificates of registration that may be issued by the commissioner of motor vehicles to five total; provides that certificates issued prior to 1/1/25 shall not be eligible for renewal.

sponsored.t: Provides an exemption for the sale of the first $35,000 of a battery, electric, or plug-in hybrid electric vehicle from state sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Provides an exemption for the sale of the first $35,000 for a battery, electric, or plug-in hybrid electric vehicle from state sales and compensating use taxes; authorizes local governments to elect such incentives; repeals the hybrid exemption after ten years.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the class for certain vehicular crimes and enacting Kane's law
sponsored.sum: Relates to increasing the class for certain vehicular crimes and enacting Kane's law; increases the class of vehicular manslaughter in the first and second degrees, aggravated vehicular homicide, and aggravated unlicensed operation in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Establishes broadband opportunity areas
sponsored.sum: Provides for real property tax exemptions for last mile broadband infrastructure constructed, altered, installed or improved in an area designated a broadband opportunity area.

sponsored.t: Relates to banning push notifications from a food service establishment or a third-party delivery platform to minors
sponsored.sum: Bans push notifications from a food service establishment or a third-party delivery platform to minors.

sponsored.t: Relates to comparing fingerprints of a defendant against the statewide database
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a court to order the division of criminal justice services to compare fingerprints of the defendant against the statewide database.

sponsored.t: Enacts the state airport facilities enforcing accountability in immigration removals (SAFE AIR) act
sponsored.sum: Prohibits public entities from contracting with airlines that transport individuals who have been detained by U.S. immigration and customs enforcement without being afforded due process rights; prohibits certain sales and use tax exemptions on fuel sold to an airline that transports individuals who have been detained by U.S. immigration and customs enforcement without being afforded due process rights.

sponsored.t: Requires the Commissioner for the Office for People with Developmental Disabilities to provide care for certain persons with developmental disabilities who have been admitted to hospitals on an emergency basis
sponsored.sum: Requires the Commissioner of the Office for People with Developmental Disabilities to provide care for certain persons with developmental disabilities who have been admitted to hospitals or psychiatric facilities on an emergency basis.

sponsored.t: Postpones the implementation and enforcement of advanced clean cars II regulations
sponsored.sum: Postpones the implementation and enforcement of advanced clean cars II regulations by the department of environmental conservation.

sponsored.t: Requires disclosure of major contributors on independent expenditure communications
sponsored.sum: Requires disclosure of major contributors on independent expenditure communications; provides language for such disclaimers.
sponsored.fis: Minimal. The bill relies on existing BOE disclosure infrastructure, with modest rulemaking and enforcement updates required.

sponsored.t: Includes flare guns in criminal possession of a weapon in the fourth degree
sponsored.sum: Adds possessing a flare gun with intent to use it unlawfully against another to the crime of criminal possession of a weapon in the fourth degree.

sponsored.t: Prohibits law enforcement officers from wearing any mask or personal disguise while interacting with the public in the performance of their duties
sponsored.sum: Prohibits local, state and federal law enforcement officers from wearing any mask or personal disguise while interacting with the public in the performance of their duties; excludes certain protective masks.

sponsored.t: Establishes a statewide student attendance and absenteeism dashboard
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of education to develop and maintain a publicly accessible statewide attendance and absenteeism dashboard to be posted publicly on the state education department's website.

sponsored.t: Establishes a pilot learner engagement and attendance program in certain school districts of the state
sponsored.sum: Establishes a three-year pilot program to be known as the "learner engagement and attendance program of New York (LEAP-NY)" in certain school districts of the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing timeframes for the payment of claims to hospitals
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing timeframes for the payment of claims to hospitals.

sponsored.t: Makes certain provisions relating to the closure or transfer of a state-operated individualized residential alternative permanent
sponsored.sum: Makes certain provisions relating to the closure or transfer of a state-operated individualized residential alternative permanent.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing blue envelopes to individuals with autism spectrum disorder
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of motor vehicles commissioner to offer, upon request, a "blue envelope" to a person who has autism spectrum disorder in order to facilitate clear and safe communication with law enforcement and provide ease of access to a driver's documentation.

sponsored.t: Establishes a reasonable accommodation reimbursement grant program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes a reasonable accommodation reimbursement grant program under which eligible employers may request a grant for reimbursement of expenses made for reasonable accommodations for applicants or employees with a disability; establishes a reasonable accommodation reimbursement fund for payment of such grants; makes an appropriation of $5,000,000 for such program.
sponsored.fis: Minimal. The bill relies on existing BOE disclosure infrastructure, with modest rulemaking and enforcement updates required.

sponsored.t: Enacts the care workforce housing preference act
sponsored.sum: Provides for the eligibility of certain households for a care workforce housing preference; provides for the method of application for such preference; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions requiring the office for people with developmental disabilities to establish the care demonstration program
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions requiring the office for people with developmental disabilities to establish the care demonstration program to March 31, 2028.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the sale of food or beverages containing kratom and 7-hydroxymitragynine
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale or offering for sale, delivery or manufacture of food or beverages containing kratom or its derivatives, or 7-hydroxymitragynine; provides penalties.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of kratom to individuals under the age of twenty-one
