sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of kratom to individuals under the age of twenty-one; imposes a civil penalty of not more than five hundred dollars for the sale or provision of kratom to any person under the age of twenty-one.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 69 Chapter 690 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 4552-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to the prohibi- tion of the sale of kratom to individuals under the age of twen- ty-one" APPROVED This bill would prohibit the sale of kratom to individuals under the age of twenty-one years. It is critical that we protect our youth from harmful substances and products, and kratom has been listed as a drug of concern by the federal Food and Drug Administration. I fully support the goals of this bill, but it needed clarifications related to the prohibition of sales outside of a retail setting and the process for enforcement. Additionally, the immediate effective date in this bill did not provide any time for kratom businesses to come into compliance, nor to put into place an appropriate infrastructure for enforcement of noncompliance. I…

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of the office of general services to erect a monument to be known as the New York state Holocaust memorial
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the office of general services to erect a monument to be known as the "New York state Holocaust memorial" in the Governor Nelson A. Rockefeller Empire State Plaza to memorialize the victims of the Holocaust and to educate the public about the history of the Holocaust and the dangers of antisemitism, racism, and all manifestations of intolerance.

sponsored.t: Provides for certain victim statements to be taken at their workplace instead of the police department
sponsored.sum: Provides for certain victim statements to be taken at their workplace instead of the police department where such workplace was the scene of the crime and is a hospital, emergency medical facility, nursing home or residential health care facility.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Justin Finkle to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible list for employment as a police officer for the Albany county sheriff
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Justin Finkle to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible list for employment as a full-time police officer for the Albany county sheriff's office; requires that Justin Finkle be otherwise subject to the merit and fitness provisions of the civil service law applicable to full-time police officers.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the use of certain park lands for any school purposes
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the use of certain park lands alienated from a portion of the park commonly known as Lincoln Park, in the city of Albany for any school purposes.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Montgomery to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Montgomery to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use taxes to November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to the imposition of sales and compensating use taxes by the county of Albany
sponsored.sum: Relates to the imposition of sales and compensating use taxes by the county of Albany; extends authorization for such tax until 11/30/2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization to impose a county recording tax on obligations secured by a mortgage on real property in Albany County
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization to impose a county recording tax on obligations secured by a mortgage on real property in Albany County.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Alexander John Smullen Traffic Safety Memorial Law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the department of transportation to establish and implement a state memorial sign program to memorialize persons who died due to injuries sustained in a fatal motor vehicle crash on state highways.

sponsored.t: Relates to the time of transfer of certain state lands to KIPP: Albany Community Public Charter Schools, and to the effectiveness of certain provisions relating thereto
sponsored.sum: Provides that the transfer of certain state lands to KIPP: Albany Community Public Charter Schools shall be made after the submission of the application to the office of general services for such transfer, and prior to the expiration of provisions authorizing such transfer; extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Establishes a center for dyslexia and dysgraphia
sponsored.sum: Establishes a center for dyslexia and dysgraphia within the department of education.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions of law relating to applied behavioral analysis
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of law relating to applied behavioral analysis.

sponsored.t: Relates to peremptory challenges where there are two or more defendants
sponsored.sum: Provides that if there is a tie when there is an even number of defendants, a peremptory challenge must be allowed.

sponsored.t: Requires the developmental disabilities advisory council to submit an annual report on the activities of the council
sponsored.sum: Requires the developmental disabilities advisory council to submit an annual report to the governor, temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly on the activities of the council, and to make such report public.
sponsored.fis: None. The DDAC is already conducting evaluations and discussions, and this measure ensures findings are formally compiled and shared.

sponsored.t: Relates to the date of school district annual organizational meetings; and repeals certain provisions of the education law relating thereto
sponsored.sum: Relates to the date of school district annual organizational meetings; allows boards of education to meet on any date on or before the Monday after July 20th for their annual organizational meeting.

sponsored.t: Requires the empire state plaza art commission to examine the historical significance of major rivers in the state of New York in connection with renaming the agency buildings located at the empire state plaza
sponsored.sum: Requires the empire state plaza art commission to examine the historical significance of major rivers in the state of New York in connection with renaming the agency buildings located at the empire state plaza; requires the governor to choose the new agency building names within 60 days after the commission's recommendation.

sponsored.t: Relates to the New York state masters-in-education teacher incentive scholarship program
sponsored.sum: Relates to the New York state masters-in-education teacher incentive scholarship program.
sponsored.fis: The Master's-in-Education Teacher Incentive Scholarship Program is esti- mated to cost $1.5 million. The New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC) announced at is May 6, 2015 Board Meeting that this scholarship program will not be implemented until the 2018-19 academic year, therefore, this bill has no cost in the current year.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the state university of New York from contracting out certain services
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the state university of New York from contracting out to the ground lessee or any subsidiary of the ground lessee or the research foundation for the state university of New York for any services or privatize any services currently being performed by employees in the unclassified service at the state university of New York at Albany.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage bluefish
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage bluefish from 2025 to 2028.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage hickory shad
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage hickory shad.

sponsored.t: Establishes standards for glass repair and calibration of advanced driver assistance systems
sponsored.sum: Establishes standards for glass repair and calibration of advanced driver assistance systems for motor vehicle glass repair facilities.

sponsored.t: Designates a portion of the state highway as the "John M. Grassia III Memorial Bridge"
sponsored.sum: Designates a portion of state route one hundred fifty-nine in the town of Rotterdam, county of Schenectady, as the "John M. Grassia III Memorial Bridge".

sponsored.t: Relates to the imposition of sales and compensating use tax in Schenectady county
sponsored.sum: Relates to the imposition of sales and compensating use tax in Schenectady county; extends such authority until November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Requires hospitals record information during intake and registration if a patient requires a disability accommodation
sponsored.sum: Requires hospitals record information during intake and registration if a patient requires a disability accommodation; allows such patient to decline such request for information.

sponsored.t: Eliminates the requirement of conducting a study on the number of children in foster care who have a disability
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the requirement of conducting a study on the number of children in foster care who have a disability; makes technical changes to certain provisions of law.
sponsored.fis: Minimal fiscal implications to the State and no fiscal impact on local governments.
